properties.value: secp256k1@3.7.0 — the ECDSA signature library for the Ethereum curve (native bindings + elliptic fallback). Required by ethereumjs-util 6.1.0, which the app's EVM Sha3 executor and web3 use. Transaction signing is delegated to the node (web3.eth.sendTransaction), but the signing stack ships in the build.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Keccak-256 (Ethereum's pre-FIPS-202 SHA-3 padding). Five lockfile declarations of keccak@1.0.2/keccakjs@0.2.1 (via ethereumjs-util/web3) plus the app's only first-party crypto call — utils.keccak256(memoryContent) in the EVM SHA3-opcode executor (Sha3.ts:25), modelling the opcode's semantics in the symbolic debugger. Quantum-safe hash; Grover square-root only.
